## Reliable child tasks and relevant memory

This release updates the maintained agent stack and its installation checks. It addresses a confirmed Claude adapter failure where a task followed by recalled memory could appear already answered before the model started work.

### Changes

- Require pi-subagent 0.6.0: precise parent-answer instructions, one 150-second wait default, role-aware tool exposure, optional tool groups, and context diagnostics.
- Keep recent inspection compact for resident and archived children. Inspection preserves final delivery and edited-file changes; repeated waits no longer replay the same final result.
- Require Eigen Memory 0.12.0: search across the assignment, preserve short identifiers/error codes, use task/project scope, skip irrelevant evidence, and deduplicate notes already in context.
- Add bounded manual memory search, paginated full reads, evidence provenance, supersession, independent controls, and on-demand recall diagnostics. Applicable earlier authorizations retain their original scope.
- Require DoppelClaude's built pending-input module. Pending task, memory and steering stay together across normal, resumed and replayed requests.
- Require PiTTy-Skills 0.2.2 with consolidated child contracts. The implementer profile is 1,996 characters shorter while retaining scope, type-safety, validation and completion duties.
- Apply a narrow, version-checked CodeGraph 0.1.11 compatibility patch: remove repeated availability rules and omit graph guidance when its tools are inactive. Preserve unfamiliar source and isolate optional patch failures from core upgrades.

### Upgrade

Run `pitty upgrade`. It refreshes installed maintained packages without changing model choices or credentials. New sessions load the updated extension code and prompts. Existing running work is not terminated by this release.

### Verification

- PiTTy: 1,317 tests passed, 43 optional tests skipped; TypeScript and runtime build passed.
- pi-subagent: 480 tests passed.
- Eigen Memory: 1,243 tests passed, one skipped; targeted final recall/compaction checks and TypeScript passed.
- DoppelClaude: 508 unit tests and three localhost native-SDK regressions passed, along with the required static checks and an offline built-package import test.
- PiTTy-Skills: manifest validation and six tests passed.

Token savings have not been measured in production. Profile reductions and recall fixture sizes are character measurements.
